Card Q&A.q: There are only opponent's Digimon with no play costs. What happens if this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates?

Card Q&A.a:
No, it can't attack. If a "can" or "may" effect activates at the same timing as a "can't" effect, the "can't" effect takes precedence.
